notes.title: Update v.0.521
notes.content:
Due to various behind the scenes issues, there was a bit of a delay on this one, sorry!

Version 0.521 doesn't have any new "features" however it represents a reasonable shift in overall balancing of Careening.

Every Weapon has had their numbers adjusted, to scale in a more linear fashion, helping the early levels feel more impactful. Additionally, the level up screen now displays more information on the stats changed compared to prior versions.

22 Buffs were added, one for each weapon, plus one extra. These are added to the buff list when you take the final level of a weapon.

With all of this in mind, balance has been completely shot, so don't be surprised if there are major buffs, and minor nerfs in the future for some weapons.

A few other points of feedback have been addressed, impact markers are a lot more visible, signs now have an outline to help them pop from the background, and both the new impact markers and damage numbers have been batched into a single particle system, which should improve their performance significantly in the late game.

Drive Safe!
-Sean

notes.title: Update v.0.52
notes.content:
This is a fairly large update, with a mix of new content, and adjustments based on player feedback.

New Features:
Deliveries - Deliverables will now spawn across the map at Doris locations, these provide experience, as well as some other bonuses when taken to the correct location. Keep an eye out for them to increase your power!

Vehicle Types - There are now three new vehicles to drive, with varied handling, stats, and special abilities.

Adjustments:

The Health Dial has been increased in size, with a new shape to help with visibility.
Engine Growl when on low health was inadvertently removed in a prior update, so that's been re-added to help give feedback to missing health.

Weapon Scaling has gone through a big pass, in general most weapons deal about 20% more damage and stun at their max level, and the scaling with each "power" upgrade has been made more linear, to help the impact of early levels. Additionally, size increases in most cases have been, well, increased.

Drive Safe!

notes.title: Early Access Launch and Update 1
notes.content:
In classic fashion, I forgot to do a post for the Early Access launch, but thank you to all my players so far, I hope you're having fun.

Today's update addresses a few bugs, but is mostly a balancing patch, there's still some work to be done there, but I think this helps bring up a few of the underperformers (and nerfs one overperformer).

Changes:

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

[h3]Bladez[/h3]
Scaling from bonus stun increased 50% ->  65%
Scaling from bonus damage decreased 100% -> 65%
(This is just to bring the values together, and buff the stun portion of Bladez which I'd overnerfed pre-release)

[h3]Flailing[/h3]
Scaling from bonus damage and stun decreased 100% -> 75%
Base Damage at level 1 decreased 5.8 -> 5.4
A few minor visual tweaks, reduced brightness and lifetime for the ribbon effects.
(Flailing had duel issues of overperforming hugely late game, combined with dealing very slightly too much damage at early levels given its relatively high attack speed, making it a little too strong if you just wanted to sit in a field power-farming)

[h3]Hot Light[/h3]
Power increased across the board slightly 20 -> 22 at max level
%Damage increases buffed 2 -> 2.2 at max level
(Again, mostly a very late game thing, but while Hot Light does very good damage, the limits of its attack pattern cause it to be a little weak late game, this helps to cement it as a weapon that scales well)

[h3]Elephant Gun[/h3]
Level 5 Crit upgrade boosted to include 50% extra Crit Damage
Base Pierce Count increase 2 ->3
Level 9 Pierce Count increased 5 -> 7
Level 6 Size upgrade reduced 1.6 -> 1.4
(Elephant Gun is supposed to be used as either a targeted attack, or a way to clear the space directly in front of you while driving, but its late game size combined with the low pierce count did reduce its efficacy in that sense, so to conteract the reduced size I've buffed it a little elsewhere)

[h3]Medieval Weaponry[/h3]
Bit of a rework to this one, it now fires in a burst, using charges of its "Pierce" to fire. This way if it fires into a big group it's about the same, but if it launches off into nothing there's a much better chance of it hitting something.
Removal of its per level size scaling.
Additionally, it now gains an extra 1 Pierce for every 10 damage it has (to a maximum of 10 extra Pierce). It'll probably need some more tweaking once I see how it performs late game.
Fixed a bug that let the mini-crossbows launch mini-crossbows (Great for damage, terrible for performance and game readability).

[h3]Magic Blast[/h3]
Damage/Stun Values increased 9/4 -> 12/6 at base, 14/6 -> 20/11 at level 11
Size at level 2 & 8 increased 1.2 -> 1.3 & 1.4 -> 1.55
(No real notes, just a buff)

[h3]American Intervention[/h3]
Base Damage/Stun increased across the board 3.5/1.5 -> 5/2.5 at base,  8.5/4.25 -> 13/6.5 at level 11
A few small visual tweaks to improve visual clarity
(Because of how its damage is calculated, the specific numbers shown here are pretty meaningless, we'll see how this unfolds in practice)


[h1]Buffs[/h1]

[list]
[*] The "Magic" weapons (Lightning, Magic Blast, Funereal) have been added to the list for Poison, Prime, and Burst
[*] Poison buffs will now appear on the buff list after any weapon gains Poison, rather than following the "Add Poison" buff being used (though, due to the order of operations, in the case of Elephant Gun reaching level 2 the poison buffs will not appear until after a buff screen has been closed)
[*] Per Level Tempo increased .25 -> .35
[*] One new buff added (Power from Point of Power, gained by visiting, you guessed it, The Point of Power. This does leave the Point of Power a little, forgive me, overpowered compared to other points (it has special spawns including a boss, + the buff), but the plan is to bring up other Points of Interest over time to even the playing field)
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
Look, this is very embarrassing, and I don't know when it was introduced, but scaling from the two final row achievements was 10 times as strong as it should have been when I checked it today. So I've fixed that, but I'm not sure how many issues that change will bring in, so I'll be monitoring it.

notes.title: Demo Update v.1.027
notes.content:
As feared, the last update broke the difficulty curve, making everything late game way too easy.

This update boosts health & stun scaling of late game enemies, doubles boss health and increases miniboss health by 25%, and includes a reduction to experience earned from defeating robots.

However, the secret fountain has been moved next to the start location, and buffs have been applied to a few weapons to help focus them on their intended use.

Weapon Changes:
Elephant Gun damage increased significantly at base level.
(and while non weapon specific, Poison Damage has been brought up significantly)

Hot Light Damage increased.

Flailing base attack pattern has been brought up to its second level, upgrade replaced by a power upgrade. Initial damage is slightly lower to compensate, but immediate DPS is much higher.

Beam Stun increased slightly across the board.
Beam explosion particles now accurate represent its AOE.

Rate of enemy spawns has been decreased at the start of each enemy group.

Bug fixes to the prime and burst achievements, and a fix to the upgraded map not displaying correctly.

notes.title: Demo Update v.1.023
notes.content:
This build represents a big step to re-align difficulty, while making a few other adjustments.

Bonus buffs have been nerfed significantly, and the better tiers of them now have prerequisites.

Medium and Large enemies have had their base stun health increased, as it was too easy early game to build enough stun up to cover the screen in stunned enemies.

Scaling of ram on stunned damage has been reduced, but a flat bonus is added, so at level 1 it's slightly stronger, but slightly weaker by level 10.

124MPH Armor, Lifesteal, and Ram damage have been reduced. This is probably an over-nerf when combined with other changes, but we'll see.

Healing now provides ticks of healing over time, rather than a burst, with a cap to how many ticks can be stored. This makes lifesteal about twice as effective early game, but reduces efficacy as the game goes on.

Fixed a bug relating to bonus health that caused lifesteal to give an erroneously high amount. This is a large nerf to lifesteal builds, but should make balancing them easier in the future.

XP from enemies has been reduced, 20% lower in the early game, and about 60% lower in end-game, to encourage focusing other sources of power.

Fountain buffs have been shifted to the bonus buff system, currently they only offer one option, like minibosses, this will likely be buffed in the future.

Achievements relating to fountain buffs have been disabled, if already earned you will keep their bonuses.

Minor changes to the landscape to improve time trial path visibility.

Flags added to points of interest.

Visuals of Flailing updated - this will probably cause some other visual problems, but I'll deal with them later.

First accessibility update, visuals of affixed enemies has changed to be more obvious, and the colours shown can be chosen from a menu. This does cause some minor visual oddities, but for now I consider them acceptable. More colours will be added later, as currently the choice is limited.

Note: A few back-end changes were made, so there may be some missing materials in some places, I will fix them as they're known.

Next patch to finish the fountain buff update and re-enable their achievements, and to improve the tutorial.

Drive Safe!

notes.title: Demo Update v.1.022
notes.content:
This is the second update to the demo, following the unannounced previous one.

This update largely involved adding minibosses to the spawn system, and tweaking how the boss buff system worked to accommodate them (one option given on mini-bosses, three options on main boss).
Nerf across the board to boss buffs to account for the total possible to receive.

Hit-Stun has been changed, with each "wave" its efficacy will reduce, and both bosses and minibosses have had their base level adjusted down.

Minimum Enemy Spawn Rate increases depending on game stage.

The Boss Bonus Buff has been removed, as the general boss buffs supersede it. I'll likely reinstate it attached to the Quest system. Currently the Exploration element of the game is a little underperforming, as fountain buffs probably need a buff as well.

Quests will now be offered more often.

Various small tweaks to weapon numbers.

Doris is more likely to be home, though may need to be tweaked up.

Boss Buffs are probably due for another hit with the nerf stick, but I'll see how user testing goes.

There were some performance issues relating to the laser that I've fixed, but there are still a few issues in testing hitting performance more than expected in the late game, so I'll be looking at that for the next update.
